topic: The Mystery of 'Both': Understanding Superposition and Quantum States
target_audience: Undergraduate science students or advanced high school students

sections.title: The Classical vs. Quantum Worldview
lecture_lines: Classical objects exist in one definite state at once.
But quantum states can merge into a single blur.
This combined state is known as quantum superposition.
A clear boundary separates the classical and quantum worlds.
The quantum side pulses with all possible outcomes.
animations: Two coins [Asset: /mmfs1/data/home/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg] labeled 'Heads' (#FFD700) and 'Tails' (#C0C0C0) appear side-by-side.
The coins [Asset: /mmfs1/data/home/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg] merge and spin into a unified grey blur (#888888).
A vertical divider (#555555) appears, and the 'Quantum' side pulses with a light glow (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Vector State Representation
lecture_lines: We represent the state zero as a vertical vector.
The state one is represented by a horizontal vector.
A superposition vector points somewhere in between.
Projections show the contribution from each basis state.
The vector shifts as the system's state changes.
animations: Two arrows labeled |0> (#00FF00) and |1> (#0000FF) form a 90-degree corner.
A yellow vector |ψ> (#FFFF00) [Asset: /mmfs1/data/home/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg] grows from the origin between them.
The |ψ> vector [Asset: /mmfs1/data/home/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg] rotates smoothly between the two axes.

sections.title: Defining the Quantum State (Psi)
lecture_lines: Quantum state Psi combines basic states zero and one.
Amplitudes alpha and beta determine each state's influence.
Squaring these amplitudes reveals the probability of each outcome.
animations: Equation |ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ fades in center screen (#FFFFFF).
The variables α (#FF00FF) and β (#00FFFF) grow and pulse.
The text 'Complex Amplitudes' (#B0E0E6) appears below the equation.
The formula |α|² + |β|² = 1 appears and glows green (#00FF00).
A fork in a path appears with a white circle (#FFFFFF) moving along both branches simultaneously.

sections.title: The Principle of Superposition
lecture_lines: Adding two valid quantum states creates another valid state.
Superposition allows states to add constructively like waves.
They can also cancel out through destructive interference.
animations: Two circles, 'State A' (#FFD700) and 'State B' (#C0C0C0), appear side-by-side.
A third circle, 'State A+B' (#FFFFFF), appears between them via a merging animation.
Three colored music note shapes (#FF00FF, #00FFFF, #FFFF00) move together and overlap.
Cyan (#00FFFF) and orange (#FF8C00) sine waves combine to create a tall white peak (#FFFFFF).
The combined white wave (#FFFFFF) ripples across the screen in a complex pattern.

sections.title: Measurement and State Collapse
lecture_lines: A quantum system exists as a swarm of possibilities.
Observing the system triggers an immediate change.
Superposition collapses into a single, definite state.
This transition is known as the state collapse.
The original quantum blur is lost upon measurement.
animations: A swarm of faint white particles (#CCCCCC) floats randomly.
A white 'Eye' icon [Asset: /mmfs1/data/home/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/eye.svg] (#FFFFFF) fades in above the swarm.
Swarm disappears, leaving one solid red circle (#FF0000).
Text 'State Collapse' (#FF0000) appears next to the circle.
Red circle stays static as the Eye icon [Asset: /mmfs1/data/home/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/eye.svg] pulses (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Application: Quantum Computing Power
lecture_lines: Classical bits are either zero or one, like switches.
Qubits use superposition to be both states at once.
Quantum computers solve complex problems exponentially faster.
animations: A classical switch [Asset: /mmfs1/data/home/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/switch.svg] flips between 0 and 1 (#FFFFFF).
A green glowing Qubit (#00FF00) displays 0 and 1 overlapping.
Maze [Asset: /mmfs1/data/home/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/maze.svg] paths highlight simultaneously in glowing yellow (#FFFF00).
